headline: Uzbekistan Offers Energy Audit Subsidies and Preferential Loans for Businesses
summary: Uzbekistan introduced financial support measures for business energy efficiency projects, including energy audit cost compensation, interest rate subsidies, and $50 million in preferential financing for solar installations.
why: Government financing initiatives and energy efficiency subsidies incentivize industrial capital expenditure in renewable energy and conservation.

impacts.name: Uzbek Industrial Sector
impacts.why: Preferential financing and subsidies lower capital expenditure hurdles for corporate energy efficiency upgrades.
